prior_exposure: Both L6 wind and L6 multivariate 2020–2025 results already inspected; all later comparisons are development backtests.
data: NOAA PSL NCEP/NCAR R1 monthly means and ERSST v5; retrospective reanalysis/reconstruction, not operational as-of inputs
representation: L12 complete real scalar and gradient/rotation vector harmonics; same source grids, domains and units as frozen L6
domains: Native grids. Ocean SST uses finite training-data domain. Pressure levels screened using bilinear surface pressure, with training-minimum mask and additional per-month screening. No zero-fill of unobserved cells.
humidity: Project log(max(q, 1e-7 kg/kg)); inverse exponential gives positive forecasts. This is a transformed-state approximation, not a humidity conservation law.
normalization: Training-only 12-month climatology; one RMS anomaly coefficient norm per physical scalar/vector channel; equal weight per channel
learner: Joint training-only EOF coordinates; separate direct ridge regression from initial EOF state to each 1–6 month target anomaly. Cross-variable and cross-mode terms permitted. No autoregressive rollout or Floquet claim.
selection: One global rank/penalty minimizing mean validation normalized coefficient MSE across all 13 channels and all six leads; all fit pairs confined to training.
comparisons: frozen L6 on the same full native observation domains
scoring: Report resolved and full observed-domain errors per channel and per lead; transformed-space q errors explicitly labeled. Physical q RMSE additionally computed against native-grid observations. Backtest not used for any selection.
publication: Separate ctmulti12 model, preserving original ctmulti L6 artifacts and URLs byte-for-byte; 1.25 degree output sampling on same latitude extent; monthly historical initial state unchanged.
projection_storage: Unique observed-domain Gram matrices with per-month indices; mathematically equivalent unregularized least squares; condition cap 1e8; no zero filling.
cross_resolution_score: Compare full observed-domain physical MSE per channel. q uses inverse-log physical kg/kg error. Aggregate each channel after dividing by the frozen L6 TRAINING climatology full physical MSE, then equal mean over 13 channels and six leads. Do not compare unequal-dimensional coefficient errors as refinement skill.
preservation: Original L6 is an independent frozen learned model, not a downsample of L12. Also expose L12 evaluated on the original 2.5 degree grid as an explicitly identified sample of the fine model.
